meta.note: Manual catalogue, seeded from the GitHub API. Each project has one primary `collection` (drives the shelf-mark layout) plus optional cross-cutting `tags`. url and repo are derived from the slug unless overridden.

collections.name: Decision & Crisis
collections.blurb: Take a seat you can't delegate and steer under hard constraints.

collections.name: Forecasting & Estimation
collections.blurb: Reason under uncertainty — decompose, calibrate, and judge precision.

collections.name: Habit & Behaviour
collections.blurb: The mechanics of automaticity, friction, and reward.

collections.name: Judgement & Leadership
collections.blurb: Hold your stated values up against how you actually act.

collections.name: Coaching & Development
collections.blurb: Exercises and workshops for coaching undergraduate students towards their goals.

collections.name: Teaching & Courses
collections.blurb: Activities and projection decks built for specific taught courses and sessions.

collections.name: Analysis & Research
collections.blurb: Instruments for describing how people and organisations actually work.

collections.name: Personal & Utilities
collections.blurb: Smaller tools built for a specific person or purpose.

projects.title: The Turnaround Board
projects.blurb: Take over a failing 84-store retailer as its crisis chief executive and reach solvency across twelve weeks of unforgiving weekly trade-offs.

projects.title: Outbreak
projects.blurb: Direct a city's response to a novel pathogen as Emergency Public Health Director, making binding weekly policy and budget decisions over twelve weeks.

projects.title: Founder's Dilemma
projects.blurb: Negotiate three venture funding rounds and an exit, discovering how term sheets and the payout waterfall decide what you personally bank.

projects.title: PEP Simulation
projects.blurb: Hold a fragile US–Iran ceasefire together through a chain of crisis decisions — built for the Hult Ignite lecture series.

projects.title: The Meridian Gazette
projects.blurb: Take the editor's chair at a struggling regional daily and balance circulation, ethics, and a tighter-than-promised budget in daily calls.

projects.title: Forecasting Pedagogy Simulations
projects.blurb: A hub of three self-contained classroom exercises — Fermi Forge, Belief Lab, and the Fox & Hedgehog Derby — with seeded, reproducible runs.

projects.title: Fermi Forge
projects.blurb: Learn Fermi estimation by decomposing impossible questions into tractable ones, from London's boiler engineers to Fermi's Trinity paper-drop.

projects.title: Fox & Hedgehog Derby
projects.blurb: Forecast twelve questions about a fictional region against Fox and Hedgehog bots, testing Tetlock's finding that cognitive style predicts accuracy.

projects.title: The Briefing Room
projects.blurb: Carry analysts' probability estimates to the President and learn when numeric precision is real signal and when it is merely decoration.

projects.title: Friction Wars
projects.blurb: Engineer the path of least resistance: spend a friction budget so the good habit becomes the easy one, in a head-to-head design game.

projects.title: Rituals & Rhythms
projects.blurb: Trace how the body clock's master pacemaker and its hormonal cascades make behaviours feel automatic, through a guided circadian-biology scenario.

projects.title: Habit-Strength Accumulator
projects.blurb: Watch automaticity build along a realistic asymptotic curve and see how long a new habit actually takes to plateau, anchored to Lally et al. (2010).

projects.title: Demand Selection
projects.blurb: A repeated free-choice task exploring how we drift toward familiar, lower-effort options over many small decisions.

projects.title: Reward-Prediction-Error Visualiser
projects.blurb: An interactive instrument showing how the dopamine surprise signal migrates from reward to predictive cue as learning takes hold.

projects.title: The Leadership Mirror
projects.blurb: A two-stage assessment testing whether the leadership values you state stay consistent with each other — and with how you act under pressure.

projects.title: The Leadership Mirror — Judgement Edition
projects.blurb: Maps where your leadership beliefs sit across contested value trade-offs and how consistently you hold them. (A variant of The Leadership Mirror.)

projects.title: Hidden Profile Paradigm
projects.blurb: Explore the pooling problem through an interactive exercise that simulates decision-making in a hidden profile scenario.

projects.title: Sarah's Gym Tracker
projects.blurb: A personal web app for logging and tracking gym workouts and progress over time.

projects.title: Psych Safety
projects.subtitle: The Sequence — climate first, challenge second
projects.blurb: Lead a team over eight rounds and learn why psychological safety must be built before you stretch people — climate first, challenge second.

projects.title: Course Planner
projects.subtitle: Course Build Tracker
projects.blurb: A personal tool for tracking course builds from planning through to completion.

projects.title: The Ledger
projects.subtitle: A day of fourteen decisions
projects.blurb: Spend a simulated day making fourteen choices that each drain or restore your reserves, learning how planning and rules protect willpower.

projects.title: Intervention Point
projects.subtitle: When you regulate decides what regulating costs
projects.blurb: Regulate an emotional reaction at different stages of a tense meeting, and discover how the timing of your intervention changes what it costs.

projects.title: Groupthink
projects.subtitle: Two rooms — how groups get things wrong together
projects.blurb: Play two short simulations of groups failing together — a safety meeting that ignores the facts it holds, and an Asch-style conformity test.

projects.title: Killswitch
projects.subtitle: Kill Criteria — a decision simulation
projects.blurb: Manage three early-stage projects over twelve weeks and decide when to kill each, reading noisy weekly signals against the kill criteria you set upfront.

projects.title: Croupier
projects.subtitle: Outcome quality vs decision quality
projects.blurb: Rate decisions, then watch each play out across ten thousand parallel worlds — separating decision quality from luck and measuring your outcome bias.

projects.title: Frontier
projects.subtitle: A facilitated team business simulation
projects.blurb: Run a rival AI company with your team across timed quarterly rounds, deciding on phones while the facilitator drives a projector screen.

projects.title: Third Places
projects.subtitle: Social Phenomena Challenge, BSc PEP
projects.blurb: A hub of classroom activities on Oldenburg's third places, from a characteristics decoder to a field-visit planner and an evidence adjudication bench.

projects.title: Lecture Slides
projects.subtitle: Projection decks for courses, workshops and talks
projects.blurb: Self-contained projection decks with built-in room activities: leading and lagging indicators, telegraphing direction to students, and an introduction to the PEP degree.

projects.title: Graticule
projects.subtitle: Organisational network analysis in the browser
projects.blurb: Map who works with whom in a team of 5 to 250 people, from roster surveys to network metrics, insights and reports.

projects.title: Coaching 1
projects.subtitle: Workshop materials
projects.blurb: Goal-setting workshop materials with a leading and lagging indicators deck and Signal Tower, a simulation of pursuing a goal through fog.

projects.title: SDC Virtual Resource Library
projects.subtitle: Interactive coaching exercises
projects.blurb: Work through coaching exercises, from satisfaction wheels and card sorts to pairwise rankings, each ending in a summary to print or save.

projects.title: List View Filter Maker
projects.subtitle: Student names to a myStudents filter
projects.blurb: Paste a column of student full names from Excel and get one separated line ready for a myStudents list-view filter.

projects.title: Term Scheduler
projects.subtitle: A term of coaching meetings, planned
projects.blurb: Turn class timetables, coach availability and student lists into a term of clash-free coaching meetings, exported as spreadsheets and calendar files.

projects.title: Materials Stores
projects.subtitle: The Suspended City · Bridge Build
projects.blurb: Run the points-based materials shop for a team bridge-building challenge, with requisitions, team balances, adjustments and a transaction ledger.
